profile.reading: This is a Carfax data center or technology facility in Boone County, Missouri, near Columbia, Missouri, where Carfax itself was founded in 1984 by Ewin Barnett III and Robert Daniel Clark, initially offering an early version of the Carfax vehicle history report to auto dealers, distributed by fax starting in 1986, which is the origin of the companys name. Carfax today maintains a database the company describes as containing more than 35 billion records drawn from more than 151,000 sources, including motor vehicle departments across all 50 US states and 10 Canadian provinces, alongside state registration records, auctions, insurance companies, repair facilities, and law enforcement agencies, all feeding its flagship Carfax Vehicle History Report product covering ownership history, accidents, title issues, fleet status, and maintenance records for used vehicles. The company has changed corporate ownership several times since its Missouri founding, acquired by R.L. Polk and Company in 1999, then IHS in 2013, IHS Markit in 2016, and S&P Global in 2022 following that companys merger with IHS Markit; S&P Global announced plans in 2025 to spin off its Mobility division, which includes Carfax, into a standalone public company. No specific power capacity or square footage figure for this Columbia area facility was found in sourcing checked this session, an honest gap this registry records rather than estimates.
